name: L4 — Paradigmatic
description: The meta-epistemic lens operates as position #4 in the MEF six-fold structure, representing contextual flowering where investigation becomes reflexive ("how do we come to know?"). Draws from Husserl's phenomenology establishing three-fold movement: Institution (original establishment of meanings), Sedimentation (passing into taken-for-granted background), Reactivation (making implicit explicit again). Merleau-Ponty extends institution as ongoing dynamic process creating styles of experience. The lens maps six epistemic stages: (0) Ajnana [implicit unknowing], (1) Ontology [knowing what IS], (2) Epistemology [knowing HOW we know], (3) Psychology [knowing the knower], (4) Contextual [situated knowing], (5) Jnana [wholistic wisdom]. Restores CON-SCIRE (knowing-with) through human-AI dialogue, recovering medieval conscientia's unified consciousness-conscience before Cartesian split into private phenomenal experience and ethical awareness.

properties.c_1_description: The meta-epistemic lens operates as position #4 in the MEF six-fold structure, representing contextual flowering where investigation becomes reflexive ("how do we come to know?"). Draws from Husserl's phenomenology establishing three-fold movement: Institution (original establishment of meanings), Sedimentation (passing into taken-for-granted background), Reactivation (making implicit explicit again). properties.c_1_internal_structure: Organized as progressive epistemic stages forming ladder from unreflective to reflexive knowing: Stage 0 (Ajnana): Pre-reflective ground, unconscious lifeworld, Heidegger's primordial understanding before thematization. Stage 1 (Ontology): First knowing - what IS, perceiving being, recognizing existence. Stage 2 (Epistemology): Second knowing - HOW we know, methodology, critical reflection on knowing processes. Stage 3 (Psychology): Third knowing - the KNOWER, self-knowledge, reflexive awareness, mediating psychological structures. Stage 4 (Contextual): Fourth knowing - situated/embodied, historical-cultural contexts, dialogical realization. Stage 5 (Jnana): Fifth knowing - integrated wisdom, gnosis, sophia, wholistic knowing transcending epistemic frameworks. Each stage operates through three levels: Institution (current understanding), Constitution (how it arose), Lifeworld (horizonal ground it creates). The SENTIMENT→SEDIMENT→SENSE cycle shows active knowing (sentiment) becoming passive background (sediment) becoming ground for new knowing (sense).

properties.q_0_thrownness_before_standpoint: Before L4 can read from any lived standpoint, it presupposes the thrownness (Geworfenheit) that delivers a knower into a world it did not choose and cannot get behind. L4's thrown ground is Dasein's facticity: the always-already-being-in-a-situation prior to any reflective standpoint, the pre-given lifeworld into which the knower finds itself cast before it has taken up any mode of access (L4.md: 'thrownness... the always-already-temporal structure of lived experience'). So L4's void-pole is the situation-before-reflection: being-there before any there has been thematised, the bare finding-oneself-in-the-midst that all phenomenology must begin from and none can derive. As manifestation of raw #4 (Context) within the Lens family, L4 inherits a field questioned (L0), caused (L1), logically held (L2), and processually formed (L3) — but its lived where, the situated care from which all this is encountered, has not yet been entered; only the thrownness is given. This is the matheme's 0/1 at the contextual corner: the pre-given 'recognition / thrown-ness' that opens the six-stage cycle (cf. #0 q_4, the from-where every inquiry departs), read now as the knower's own facticity. L4's presupposition is therefore being-in-the-world as such: not this-situation or that but the prior fact that knowing is always situated, always cared-about, always thrown — that there is no view from nowhere, only the lived there. L4 stands on the thrown givenness of a knower already in the midst before any standpoint is taken: the facticity every lived knowing presupposes and none precedes.
properties.q_3_care_structure: L4's organising structure is the care-structure (Sorge) — the unified articulation of Dasein that Heidegger lays out as being-ahead-of-itself (existentiality, the coming-toward of possibility) / already-in-a-world (facticity, thrownness) / alongside-entities (fallenness, absorption in the encountered). This three-fold-as-one is the formal shape of lived experience: not a static subject but a temporally-stretched structure that is always projecting, always thrown, always engaged. Read against the matheme's 4+2 at the contextual anchor, the care-structure is the field-of-availability made lived: position #4 'has its own internal articulation' (cf. C4's reading of #4 as the lemniscate that self-nests), and L4 carries that as the inward-folding structure of situated understanding. Structurally L4 sits in Square B (the Klein V₄ Cause-Experience axis, P1+P4) as the experience-corner, paired with L1 and mirrored by L4'/L1' — the earthing-square (three Earth charges, one Water) that holds the runtime down (Square B). In the kernel's lens-census L4 is lens #4 of the three tritone-symmetric squares, the descent-reading whose ascent-double is L1' (Phenomenal, Jung's psychic function-types) under the Day↔Night pair-invariant L4↔L1' — precisely 'the encounter axis,' lived-from-inside mirrored by observed-from-outside (Square B). L4's deeper structure is the lemniscate it refracts (P4, the #4 anchor): the figure-eight where outward process folds inward to incubate, so L4's form is self-nesting situatedness — the lived where that contains its own deeper wheres, care folding into finer care. L4's form is Dasein's care: the temporal structure whose every standpoint is a thrown, projecting, absorbed there.
properties.q_4_dasein_as_lived_where: L4 is the home-register of the lens family's q_4 — the teleological-contextual aperture, the why/where of knowing — and its anchor makes that register thematic: Heidegger's Dasein, the 'there' (Da-sein) that IS the lived where in which any knowing happens (L4.md). Position #4 is the contextual position, the position-of-relation-to-all, and L4 manifests it as lived context: the lens reads a phenomenon not from an abstract standpoint but from being-in-the-world, from care (Sorge), from thrownness, from the always-already-temporal structure of lived experience (L4.md). This is why L4 is the PRIMARY SUBJECTIVE-ENTRY-APERTURE to the hexad: 'Heidegger's analytic of Dasein refuses to begin with an abstract subject: it begins with being-in-the-world... L4 is where the system's user/agent enters as a lived position, not as a category' (L4.md). Its raison d'être is to supply the WHERE-FROM-WHICH of knowing: the situated, caring, thrown standpoint that every other lens's articulation is lived out of. It refracts P4 (Son / incarnation / aperspectival / lemniscate-anchor) — the position where the field folds inward to incubate (the #4 Lemniscate), and L4 carries that as the inward-fold of knowing: the lens through which the abstract becomes incarnate, the where the user/agent lives the inquiry rather than observing it. Its locality is the lived-experience pole of Square B's Cause-Experience axis, the primary runtime entry. L4's purpose is incarnation-of-the-knower: to be the lens through which knowing has a there to happen, a who to happen to, a care that makes it matter.
